test_video_gpt_encode: test the video_gpt model encode method to encode input video tensors into latent representations
test_video_gpt_decode: test the video_gpt model decode method to decode token sequences back into video tensors
test_video_gpt_lookup: test the video_gpt model lookup method to retrieve embeddings for input or output tokens
test_video_gpt_forward: test the video_gpt model full forward pass with attention masks and caching enabled
test_video_vqvae: test the video_vqvae model to encode and decode video frames through the vector quantized VAE
